Ulixa Territory Cities — 236 Territories

Search a city and state to find the two closest territories by driving distance to their named cities. C is your searched city; 1 and 2 are destination cities. Tap a pin for details.
Type a city and state in one field. Examples: “Waukee, Iowa”, “Waukee, IA”, or “Des Moines Iowa”.
Driving miles follow the routing engine’s recommended car route between mapped city centers. Distances exclude the short road-access offsets shown in each result. For multi-city territories, the nearer named city is used; directional sectors share their underlying city center. Times exclude live traffic. No API key required.
Data sources and distance method

Road routes: FOSSGIS / OSRM, using OpenStreetMap data (ODbL). City centers: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0), downloaded October 15, 2026. Fix the map.

The free community router is for light use: requests are spaced at least 1.1 seconds apart and routes are cached for seven days when browser storage is available. The router receives the searched city and destination coordinates. Availability is not guaranteed. No Google Maps services or API keys are used.

All 236 territory labels are retained. Territories covering several named cities use the closest of those cities by road. Region names such as Keys and North Space Coast are not point destinations. Directional territory labels use their underlying city center. West New York is in New Jersey and East Chicago is in Indiana; those destination states correct inconsistent original territory labels. The Neptune territory uses Neptune City as an explicitly named reference. Exact addresses may yield different mileage.
